description_en: Updates the memory of a DataAgent
kebab_example: aliyun dms update-data-agent-memory --dms-unit cn-hangzhou --uuid ed3f6700000000000ed --content Diamond_pricing_analysis_requires_examining_the_skewness_and_outliers_of_the_distribution_of_each_feature. --mem-from user --from-id 8zm30000000000g3yxa1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDataAgentMemory

parameters.example: Diamond pricing analysis requires examining the skewness and outliers of the distribution of each feature.
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en:
The memory source. Valid values:

session: generated from a session.
user: edited by a user
parameters.help_zh:
记忆来源
会话生成：session
用户编辑：user
parameters.name: mem_from

parameters.help_en:
The source ID.
If MemFrom is set to session, FromId indicates the session ID.
If MemFrom is set to user, FromId indicates the RAM user ID
parameters.help_zh:
来源ID
当MemFrom为session时：FromId表示会话ID
当MemFrom为user时，FromId为用户子账号ID
parameters.name: from_id
